kurz: Melt and cool chocolate so that it sets with shine and snap.
bild_im_kopf: Like teaching a group to line up: first break everyone up, then add the right role models.
was_passiert: The simplest method is seeding: melt two thirds, then stir in one third of finely chopped, tempered chocolate. The solid pieces bring the right crystals, which the melted chocolate lines up on.
schritte: Melt two thirds of the chocolate over a water bath to 45–50 °C.
Stir in the remaining third, finely chopped, until it has melted.
Bring to working temperature (dark 31–32 °C, milk 29–30 °C, white 28–29 °C).
Test: dip in a knife; after a few minutes the chocolate should be glossy and firm.
Hold at working temperature and work quickly.
